diffs.diff: distance_mm: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: DFRobot SEN0311 wiki, Communication Protocol: 'Distance= Data_H*256+ Data_L=0X07A1; Equal to 1953 when converted into decimal; Represent the current measured distance is 1953mm.' So 1 mm per count, offset 0. The model already encodes exactly this: sim.unit is 'mm' and sim.uartStream sends the value control as a 16-bit field with scale 1 (no offset), and the driver returns (DATA_H << 8) | DATA_L as mm; the example test sets 1953 and expects 'D=1953mm'. The gate reports 'none' only because its conversion extractor reads sim.measure/measures/responses and not sim.uartStream.
